references.text: Balak took Balaam to the top of Pisgah, the same place mentioned in Israel's journey route.
Moses was told to go up to the top of Pisgah to see the land, the same mountain peak mentioned here.
Moses went up Mount Pisgah from the plains of Moab, where he saw the promised land before his death.
Part of the same journey route through the region of Moab described in this passage.
A parallel description of Israel's journey that includes the mountains of Abarim near Moab.
The mountains of Abarim and Nebo are mentioned as the place where Moses was to see the land, in the same geographic area as Pisgah.
